weights: parent weights sum to one; normalize mean training weight only; no class rebalancing
preprocessing: float32 input, train-only weighted mean log1p imputation/scaling; mask preserved; train vocabulary unknown=0; no IDs, ports, absolute timestamps, source or labels

experiments.E1: base(16 numeric+mask) vs full43+mask; prefix unavailable and no fabricated sequence
experiments.E2: same roles, weights and per-fit wall budget for XGBoost/LightGBM/CUDA MLP
E3: remove controlled benign from train to measure benefit of difficult tasks
zero host-global context and coverage features to diagnose source/host confounding
experiments.E4: deferred: no independently qualified prefix/sequence profile; do not train incompatible sequence models
experiments.E5: rules, model-only, model+policy under identical zero benign-opportunity false-action budget
experiments.E6: separate by source/task/quality and report one positive activity per role; no generalization claim

selection: maximize selection observed-final opportunity coverage at zero false benign opportunities; tie lower parent-weighted log loss then deterministic experiment id; winner base seed retained, other seeds variance only; freeze before calibration

calibration.method: positive-slope Platt on clipped raw logits

metrics.primary: strict timely block recall unavailable without per-activity onset and qualified prefix; never substitute final score for early-block success
metrics.diagnostic: observed-final target/30-second opportunities; label=attack only if all rows attack, mixed target bucket is ambiguous and false if affected
metrics.actions: candidate only; same full target incl sensor/boot/capture/keyEpoch, TTL dedup, latest parent evidence, budgets; no real executor
metrics.confidence: activity-cluster bootstrap unavailable when fewer than 5 attack or benign independent groups; do not use snapshot binomial intervals
metrics.latency: ONNX CPU timing only, never OS enforcement latency

exit: at least one supported family meets registered precision/coverage and positive E5 gain; insufficient onset/groups/sample counts or two rounds no net gain => blocked/failed with root-cause report, no P6 approval
